MILAAN · YOUR RECORDS

Privacy Policy

Milaan is an independent software project founded and operated by Bilal Ahmed, an individual based in Pakistan. It is not yet a registered company and has no registered business office.

Draft for legal review — not a finalized policy. Prepared 25 October 2026. An effective date will be added after review. Support contact, data-request procedures, provider retention and backup arrangements still need confirmation before public onboarding.

Information we process and why

Milaan compares seller-assigned Order numbers, payment screenshot Transaction IDs and supplied statements. Saved batches can include customer names, amounts, account details, statement rows, receipt images, extracted fields, decisions and review reasons. Account information includes your email address, display name and password hash. These records support reconciliation, account access, review history and protection against unauthorized use. Upload only information you are entitled to process and avoid unrelated sensitive documents.

Retention and deletion

New batches normally expire after 168 hours (seven days). Expired batches become inaccessible even if physical deletion has not finished. The running worker processes expired records and queues deletion of private receipt files; storage errors or a sleeping server can delay erasure. Deleting a batch removes its associated working records, while receipt deletion is retried in the background. Your account and seller profile remain. Resetting a batch clears results and allocations but retains its inputs and earlier history until deletion or expiry. Export records you need before expiry.

Pending confirmation: retention of account data, service logs, provider backups and old object versions; backup expiry; and deletion across restored copies. This draft does not promise immediate or complete physical erasure from every backup.

Receipt privacy and account security

Receipts are decoded, resized and stored as private JPEG images without their original EXIF metadata. Saved receipt routes check authentication and account ownership. Passwords are hashed, sessions expire and can be revoked, and browser sessions use CSRF protection. These measures reduce risk but cannot guarantee absolute security. Hosting-provider access, operator access procedures and incident-response arrangements require review.

Optional AI and browser OCR

You can enter and correct receipt fields manually. If Gemini reading is configured and you explicitly consent to cloud processing, the receipt image is sent to Google's Gemini service for suggested fields. You must check the result against the original evidence. The applicable Google processing terms and retention settings remain to be confirmed.

The fictional demo is separate from saved server records. Optional browser-local OCR may download an external OCR engine. Download providers can receive connection metadata; local OCR does not independently verify a payment. The OCR download services, their privacy terms and retention practices require confirmation.

Authentication email and other service providers

Milaan uses the Resend HTTPS API for account verification and password recovery emails only. These messages include the recipient address and a verification code or recovery link, not uploaded orders, receipts or statements. Resend delivery, tracking and retention settings remain subject to verification.

The current hosting arrangement uses Render and Neon, with services configured in Singapore. Provider-specific processing locations, subprocessors, backup locations and international-transfer requirements must be reviewed before a final policy is published. External font and OCR downloads may also disclose connection metadata to their providers.

Cookies and browser storage

Browser sessions use an authentication cookie; remembered sessions have a finite lifetime and can be revoked. Interface preferences may be stored locally. Protect shared devices and sign out when finished. The complete browser-storage and third-party request inventory remains part of the launch review.

Data requests and contact

A support email is not configured yet. No support inbox or response-time commitment is currently offered. Do not send personal or financial records through public GitHub issues. A private contact channel, identity-check procedure, response periods and applicable access, correction and deletion rights must be documented before public onboarding.

Policy status and updates

Public registration remains closed pending successful real email verification testing and the operator's approval. This draft describes current application behavior and outstanding work; it is not a compliance certification. Applicable legal grounds, audience or age restrictions, and the process for notifying users of material changes require legal review in Pakistan and any other applicable jurisdiction.

Every payment, in its place. · Milaan
